title: Chicken Alfredo pasta
description: Rich and creamy pasta with tender chicken tossed in a garlic parmesan cream sauce and fettuccine.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the fettuccine pasta until al dente, then drain.
Season the chicken breasts with a portion of the salt and black pepper.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the chicken breasts for 6 to 7 minutes per side until cooked through, then slice.
In a large pan, melt the butter over medium heat and sauté the minced garlic for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the heavy cream and let it simmer gently for 3 minutes to thicken.
Stir in the grated Parmesan cheese until melted and smooth, creating a creamy sauce.
Add the remaining salt and black pepper to the sauce.
Toss the cooked fettuccine pasta into the alfredo sauce until well coated.
Top the pasta with the sliced chicken breast and serve hot.
